Package models

Class FoodBank

java.lang.Object
models.FoodBank
public class FoodBank extends Object
FoodBank.java This class represents a Food Bank entity with various attributes and methods to manage its data. It includes fields for primary key, organization name, user data index, accommodation limit, hours of operation, location coordinates, address, contact information, location notes, and permanent status.
